hero.title: Make AI truly yours.
hero.body: Nimi Home is your everyday entry point to AI, apps, and companions. Use apps to write, research, and create, or talk with companions that each have their own personality and memory.
hero.availability: Public Beta · Apple Silicon Mac / Windows x86_64 · Nimi account required
hero.note: Open-source and local-first. Your choice of models.
hero.peek: From an idea to getting it done.
hero.metaDescription: Nimi is an installable, open-source, local-first personal AI product. Explore apps and companions, choose local or cloud AI, connect tools, and build your own apps with the SDK and Kit.
experience.eyebrow: One foundation. Many ways to use AI.
experience.title: AI should be more than a chat box.
experience.body: Talk through an idea, get things done in an app, or spend time with a familiar companion. Different interfaces serve different purposes.
experience.chatDetail: Start with a question. Ordinary AI chat does not require a local companion.
experience.appsDetail: Each app stays responsible for its own tasks. Ordinary apps can use Nimi’s protected AI capabilities directly.
experience.partnerDetail: Between Home and Zhiyu, you’re always talking with the same companion—picking up your conversation right where you left off, along with allowed memories. Work apps keep their own materials separate and don’t read chat history by default.
experience.memoryDetail: A companion’s identity, chats, and long-term memory stay distinct instead of blurring together. You can see each memory’s source, edit it, or remove it from long-term memory—without deleting or rewriting the original chat.
experience.manageDetail: From creation through everyday life, a companion’s settings, memory, and proactive behavior stay open to view and adjust. Turn off proactive companionship whenever you want quiet—you can still start a manual chat anytime.
experience.reply: To move forward, you can switch to an app interface suited to the task.
experience.memoryEmpty: This companion has no memories yet.
experience.proactiveNote: Proactive companionship is separate from manual chat, so turning it off won't stop you from chatting manually. Real execution also depends on configuration, budget, and runtime conditions.
worlds.title: Step into distinct worlds and meet who lives there.
worlds.body: From historical lives to alien oceans, this gallery features curated selections from published worlds and characters. Open a world, learn where its characters come from, and select a favorite.
worlds.drag: Drag to explore, or use the left and right arrow keys
worlds.audioError: Could not play the voice sample. Please try again.
worlds.note: This gallery features curated content and existing voice clips from published worlds and characters. Published characters are distinct from local companions: selecting one here does not create a local companion on your device, as local companions are created independently in Nimi Home.
power.title: Run locally. Reach the cloud when you need it.
power.body: Choose local or cloud for each task—no need to pick just one.
power.imageTask: Create an image for a story
power.localDetail: Inference stays on your device and uses its resources. Sign-in, downloads, and online features still need internet access.
power.cloudDetail: The required input and context go to your chosen cloud service, with usage billed by that provider.
showcase.eyebrow: NIMI APPS · Built for real tasks
showcase.title: Find your Nimi App.
showcase.body: Explore 23 app previews. Choose an icon or browse the apps to see how each can help.
integrations.title: Pick up the tools and results you need.
integrations.body: Find information, send a message, or build on another app’s work without copying and pasting between windows. You decide which apps can use each connection.
integrations.mcpDetail: Find what you need in a connected tool.
integrations.telegramDetail: Send finished content to a chosen conversation.
integrations.appDetail: Use a finished version from another app.
integrations.mcpScope: Let NimiGo find information for the current task in a tool you have authorized.
integrations.telegramScope: Use an authorized Telegram connection to send content to your chosen conversation.
integrations.appScope: Let NimiDay read a finished result from NimiGo and continue the current task.
integrations.mcpResult: NimiGo found the information and kept its source, ready for you to organize.
integrations.telegramResult: Telegram accepted the message. Check Telegram for delivery and read status.
integrations.appResult: NimiDay read result v1 from NimiGo. Later updates will not change what was used here.
integrations.footnote: Available features vary by tool. These protections cover Nimi-managed calls only.
security.accessDetail: Access scope is derived from declarations and the current protected session.
security.credentialDetail: Nimi or your chosen trusted executor holds the raw keys. Apps use only the features you allow.
security.checkDetail: Checks supported complete, unencrypted PEM private-key blocks and GitHub classic PAT formats in text.generate.
security.request: Help me inspect this connection log.
security.ready: Edit the example request to explore the content-check flow.
security.refused: The example input was blocked. Your draft is preserved for you to edit and try again.
security.editNote: Your draft is preserved. Edit it to try the demo again.
security.sent: The example flow is complete. Nothing was sent to a model.
security.scope: Inputs · Generated output · Complete tool arguments
security.limit: Once displayed, text cannot be recalled. Images, audio, video, and arbitrary encodings are out of scope. This is not comprehensive leak prevention, and it does not detect prompt injection.
security.note: Content checks are a developer preview in current source builds. See release notes for packaged availability.
security.noSandbox: These boundaries cover Nimi-managed calls, not the entire operating system or every action an app can take.
builder.title: Build an AI app around the way you work.
builder.body: Use the SDK to access capabilities, pick Kit components as needed, and create, develop locally, and package with App Tools. You decide the interface and business logic, and each app keeps ownership of its own business state.
builder.sdkDetail: Use AI, agent, and integration capabilities within app permissions through typed, protected public interfaces.
builder.kitDetail: Reuse chat, agent-center, and model-configuration React components as needed. Kit isn’t a mandatory framework, so your app keeps its own UI and identity.
builder.toolsDetail: Create projects from the supported feature catalog, then use the CLI for checks, tests, Desktop-supervised protected local dev, and app packaging.
builder.note: For creators with development experience—not a no-code generator. Projects are created and packaged via the CLI, and packaging does not mean public listing or release review.
footer.heading: Start with something you want to do.
footer.body: Choose an app, meet a companion, or build a tool of your own.
footer.cost: Nimi itself is free and open source. Cloud services follow their providers’ billing rules, and third-party app licenses and pricing are set by their publishers.
hero.homeEyebrow: NIMI HOME · Your AI entry point
hero.homeTitle: Start in Home. Make yourself at home.
hero.homeBody: Explore Nimi Home right in this window. It connects with the sections below: characters you choose join this list, and conversations and demo memories with the same companion continue between Home and the Zhiyu app.
builder.copyError: Copy failed. The command has been expanded—select and copy it manually.
experience.memorySeed: Want to continue talking about light and shadow in brick paintings next time.
common.actionError: This action could not be completed. Please try again.
integrations.mcpAction: The information you need, sources included.
integrations.telegramAction: Send finished writing to your chosen conversation.
integrations.appAction: Pick up where another app left off.
integrations.demoNote: An illustrated example only. No real information is read and no messages are sent.
integrations.permissionDetail: Allow specific apps to use selected actions and targets. That permission stays in place until you revoke it.
security.demoNote: The demo responds only to the example marker. It does not detect real keys or call a model.
